title: Chapter 3 - Life Frequency
excerpt: Chapter 3    Life Frequency: Applying Frequency Memory in Daily Life    Introduction  Life Frequency means actively using learned frequency memories in real-time situations.  It is the moment where awareness, choice, and embodiment come together.  You are no longer reacting automatically.  You are selecting a frequency.  Every situation has a dominant frequency:  • Conflict    • Stress    • Cooperation    • Fear...

public_profile.hook: Applying learned states in work, decisions, and daily life.
public_profile.summary: Life Frequency moves the method into real situations. It is about recognising the dominant frequency of the moment and choosing how you answer it.
